newsitem.title: UK: Gasoline blender interest supports NWE MTBE market.
newsitem.headline: Gasoline blender interest supports NWE MTBE market.

text.p: NWE MTBE prices held stable in quiet trade on Tuesday.
Traders said some light blender buying interest on the back of seasonally firmer gasoline sentiment was supportive but otherwise buying interest was thin with transatlantic arbitrage options closed.

Ample supplies in the U.S. and a stable European market at around $270 a tonne fob ARA left arbitrage mathematics from Europe around $20 a tonne away from working, though traders said some players were shipping product transatlantic.
Spot prices continued weak in the U.S, weighed down by ample supply and tight storage space on the East Coast.
Storage in New York Harbour for MTBE and gasoline has largely been filled by imports that arrived a few weeks ago, when the arbitrage window was open.
